messages.subject: Time recording - December narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our records show 6.5 hours recorded in December without narratives across two matters. Please add narratives by Monday so we can finalise the January bills. WIP write-off deadline is the 5th.

Thanks,
Accounts
